tiles.name: Customer Logo Tile
tiles.description: Square tiles displaying customer/partner logos with optional hover states and link overlays. Features grayscale logos with opacity treatment.

tiles.name: Featured Customer Tile
tiles.description: Larger 2-column spanning tile with background image, customer logo, headline metric, and description. Used to highlight key customer success stories.

tiles.name: Testimonial Card
tiles.description: Fixed-height cards displaying customer testimonials with company logo, name, title, and quote. Used in horizontally scrolling carousel.

tiles.name: Live Metrics Ticker
tiles.description: Real-time counter badges showing live platform metrics (receipts processed, accounting fields coded, etc.) with number-flow animation.
